chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon them:
About a man who sees the crescent in the Month of Ramadan by himself, and no one else sees it: should he fast?
He said: "If he has no doubt, then let him break the fast; otherwise, let him fast it with the people."

key_terms.الْهِلالَ: the crescent moon marking the beginning or end of the lunar month
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of fasting in Islam
key_terms.فَلْيُفْطِرْ: then let him break the fast
key_terms.لَمْ يَشُكَّ: he is not doubtful and has certainty
key_terms.مَعَ النَّاسِ: in accordance with the people or public observance

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he alone sees the Ramadan crescent?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about acting on personal moon-sighting in relation to Ramadan. It indicates that certainty has legal consequence, while doubt requires conformity with the public observance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1915 - Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)
about a man who sees the crescent for the Month of Ramadan alone, and no one else sees it. Should he fast?
Imam (as) said: "If he has no doubt, let him break his fast. Otherwise, let him fast with the people."
